title.narrative: To reduce HIV infections by 85%, new HIV infections among children by less than 4%, AIDS related deaths by 80%; and HIV related stigma to 5%, all from 2010 baseline by 2025. - Tanzania (United Republic) (01-Jan-2024-30-Jun-2025)

description.narrative: Tanzania (United Republic), TB/HIV, Management and Development for Health (MDH) (MDH)This program has the following goals: To reduce new HIV infections by 85% in 2025 from the 2010 baseline (110,000).. To reduce Mother to Child Transmission by the end of breastfeeding to ≤4% by 2025.. To reduce AIDS related deaths by 80% in 2025 from the 2010 baseline (64,000). To reduce HIV related stigma to <5% by 2025 from 2013 baseline of 28% for external stigma and 20.5% for internal stigma.. To reduce burden and suffering from Tuberculosis and Leprosy diseases in Tanzania by 2025. The objectives of this program are: To implement efficient testing strategies so that 95% of people living with HIV will know their status by 2026. To reduce HIV related stigma to less than 5% by 2025 from 2013 baseline of 25% for external stigma and 20.5% for internal stigma.. To reduce the percentage of mother to child transmission at the end of breast feeding period, from an estimated 7.9% (in 2021), to <4% by the end of 2025/6. To increase TB treatment coverage from 53percent in 2018 to 90percent by innovatively addressing barriers to access, utilization, and the needs of the key and vulnerable populations for TB care and prevention services. To strengthen TB services to the population of miners and their families by 2025
